blocks.text: Doorfold makes room by opening a little space within itself. It echoes the world’s shelters and nested spaces without containing a person, a memory archive, or a passage to another world.
A palm-sized teal folded architectural object, three interlocking ceramic doorframes around a floating apricot bead, deep navy recesses and ivory edges, unusual pocket shrine with no writing.
One-shot use: The nested frames rise into open doorways and the orange core extends into a bright column. The game performs the final fade.
19 silver. Stress severity −2; reaching zero clears the condition. Happiness +5; Energy +5. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.
